facts.en: Completed a business administration diploma at Fictional Larchwell College in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构落叶松井学院完成工商行政文凭课程。

facts.en: Paid intake clerk at Fictional Peartree Mutual from 2024-02 to 2026-05.
facts.zh: 2024-02 至 2026-05 在虚构梨树互助公司任有薪受理文员。

facts.en: Opened intake records for household-item claims and attached documents supplied by applicants.
facts.zh: 为家居物品理赔建立受理记录，并附上申请人提供的文件。

facts.en: Compared submitted document lists with the company’s intake checklist and requested missing pages.
facts.zh: 将提交的文件清单与公司受理核对表比较，并请求补交缺失页。

facts.en: Used approved wording to acknowledge receipt without promising a claim decision or payment.
facts.zh: 使用获批措辞确认收到材料，不承诺理赔决定或付款。

facts.en: Sent coverage and valuation questions to assigned claims handlers.
facts.zh: 将保障范围及估值问题转交指定理赔经办人。

facts.en: Maintained file names, received dates and handler assignments in a shared register.
facts.zh: 在共享登记表中维护文件名、收件日期及经办人分配信息。

facts.en: A 2026-03 supervisor check found all mandatory intake fields present in 42 of 45 sampled files prepared by the candidate.
facts.zh: 2026-03 的主管检查发现，候选人准备的 45 份抽样档案中有 42 份包含全部受理必填字段。

facts.en: The check covered intake completeness; claim outcomes and settlement amounts were outside its scope.
facts.zh: 该检查涵盖受理材料完整性；不涉及理赔结果及赔付金额。

facts.en: Helped test a revised missing-page email template in 2025-04 using 12 invented cases.
facts.zh: 2025-04 使用 12 个虚构案例协助测试修订后的缺页邮件模板。

facts.en: Personally recorded unclear wording; a claims handler approved the final template.
facts.zh: 个人记录不清晰措辞；最终模板由一名理赔经办人批准。

facts.en: Uses spreadsheet filters, document indexes and standard email templates.
facts.zh: 使用电子表格筛选、文件索引及标准邮件模板。

facts.en: Handled records in a restricted internal folder and followed the employer’s access instructions.
facts.zh: 在受限内部文件夹中处理记录，并遵循雇主的访问权限说明。

facts.en: Completed an internal confidentiality induction in 2024-02; it did not confer an external compliance qualification.
facts.zh: 2024-02 完成内部保密入职培训；未授予外部合规资格。

facts.en: A team dashboard counted 210 closed intake tasks in 2026-03, but the export did not identify how many belonged to the candidate.
facts.zh: 团队仪表板统计 2026-03 有 210 项已关闭受理任务，但导出文件未标明其中多少属于候选人。

facts.en: The supplied records do not define whether a closed intake task means a complete file, a withdrawn request or another administrative status.
facts.zh: 所提供记录未定义已关闭受理任务是指完整档案、已撤回请求还是其他行政状态。

facts.en: As coursework in 2023, made a fictional stationery-order tracker with no insurance data.
facts.zh: 2023 年作为课程作业制作虚构文具订单跟踪表，不含保险数据。

facts.en: Volunteered to sort event badges at Fictional Paperboat Fair in 2022-10.
facts.zh: 2022-10 志愿为虚构纸船集市整理活动胸牌。

facts.en: Enjoys photographing handmade paper textures.
facts.zh: 爱好拍摄手工纸纹理。

facts.en: No claim-adjudication authority or independent coverage assessment is recorded.
facts.zh: 未记录理赔裁定权限或独立保障范围评估经历。
